svg.title: Daily CH₄ and N₂O flux against the daily soil water content at Anttila (mineral soil), Särkisuo (drained peat) and Viikki (clay loam): median per 0.02 m³ m⁻³ bin with the 25 to 75 % band.
svg.desc: Two panels, one above the other: CH₄ flux (µmol m⁻² s⁻¹, top) and N₂O flux (nmol m⁻² s⁻¹, bottom) against the daily mean soil water content (m³ m⁻³, shared x axis). Each line is the median of the daily means per 0.02 m³ m⁻³ bin with the 25 to 75 % band. CH₄: Anttila: ρ 0.03 (n = 724 days), swc 0.11 to 0.45 m³ m⁻³; Särkisuo: ρ 0.11 (n = 504 days), swc 0.29 to 0.80 m³ m⁻³. N₂O: Anttila: ρ −0.28 (n = 724 days), swc 0.11 to 0.45 m³ m⁻³; Särkisuo: ρ −0.30 (n = 504 days), swc 0.29 to 0.80 m³ m⁻³; Viikki: ρ 0.30 (n = 1294 days), swc 0.10 to 0.53 m³ m⁻³. CH₄ against soil water content: Anttila no clear monotonic relation; Särkisuo a weak positive relation. N₂O against soil water content: Anttila a weak negative relation; Särkisuo a weak negative relation; Viikki a weak positive relation. The fluxes are gap-filled values. Flux > 0 = emission.
